checks: Presets, HEX input, keyboard-operated sliders and exact number inputs update the real article; invalid color text preserves the last valid color.
Pausing and frame scrubbing freeze the layers at the selected time; clipboard JSON contains the tuned settings, units, blend mode, timings and rendered frame.
CSS copies the active variables and the downloaded JSON matches the selected settings.
Import reports malformed JSON without discarding settings; valid imports survive a reload.
Clean-background preview restores the article when collapsed; Escape returns keyboard focus to the launcher.
The panel and export buttons stay within the viewport from 320 to 1920 px.
Reduced motion preserves a static light preview and disables animation controls.
Blocked clipboard access exposes selected JSON for manual copying.
Client-side page changes dispose the editor; returning mounts a single launcher.
